properties.statement: Wrote a script to count what fraction of a node type carries a given relation or property — rules whose text cites another rule, decisions with a supersedes or evolves-into edge to another decision, defect facts and rules per month, decision-to-decision edges by type. Searched the surface first: the nearest served thing counts vocabulary usage, not the share of a population that carries a relation; the accepted requirement asking for exactly this is still unsatisfied.
